releaseNotes: V983 enforces ICEops Deterministic Evaluation (E2) as the final authority for whether a Process Condition was actually evaluated. A configured Alarm Rule or raw fields such as alarm_active=false, alarm_context=Normal, or live_current_state=HEALTHY can no longer be promoted by the LLM into an evaluated HEALTHY/NORMAL port verdict when E2 coverage is zero.

A new deterministic evaluation-authority normalizer corrects contradictory evaluated/not-evaluated counts and removes unsupported per-port or all-port positive Condition classifications when E2 did not evaluate them. The normalized answer is still validated by the unchanged AiGroundingValidator before display.

The default all-port AI question is upgraded from a simple status summary to a comprehensive operator prompt covering Operational Status, Process Condition, connection/polling/faults/active alarms/data freshness, trend/current values, evaluation coverage, Criteria Source, and prioritized Evidence-backed actions. General and Operations status prompts are localized for KR/EN/JP/CN/DE/ES.

V979 semantic neutralization, V980 VERDICT repair, V981 localized heading canonicalization, V982 required-section repair, the deterministic evaluator decision logic, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, AI Data Library, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths remain unchanged.

en: E2 now remains the final authority for whether a port Condition was actually evaluated; configured criteria and raw HEALTHY/Normal fields cannot be promoted into a Process Condition verdict by the LLM.
Contradictory evaluation counts and unsupported per-port/all-port Condition claims are deterministically reduced to the existing E2 result and revalidated by the unchanged Grounding validator.
The default AI question is now a comprehensive operator prompt covering operations, Condition, coverage, Criteria Source, evidence and prioritized actions.
ko: E2 Deterministic Evaluation을 Port Condition의 실제 평가 완료 여부에 대한 최종 권위로 강제했습니다. Criteria 설정 또는 raw HEALTHY/Normal 필드만으로 AI가 Process Condition을 정상으로 승격할 수 없습니다.
E2와 다른 평가/미평가 수치 및 Port별/전체 Condition 주장은 결정론적으로 E2 결과로 축소한 뒤 기존 Grounding Validator로 다시 검증합니다.
AI 기본 질문을 운영 상태, Condition, Coverage, Criteria Source, Evidence와 우선 조치까지 한 번에 요청하는 종합 문구로 개선했습니다.
ja: E2 Deterministic Evaluation を Port Condition の実際の評価完了有無に対する最終権限として強制し、設定済み Criteria や raw HEALTHY/Normal フィールドだけで Process Condition を昇格できないようにしました。
E2 と矛盾する評価数や Port/全体 Condition 主張は決定論的に E2 結果へ縮約し、既存 Grounding Validator で再検証します。
AI の既定質問を運転状態、Condition、Coverage、Criteria Source、Evidence、優先対応を含む総合オペレータ向け質問に更新しました。
zh-CN: 将 E2 Deterministic Evaluation 强制作为端口 Condition 是否真正完成评估的最终权威；仅有已配置 Criteria 或 raw HEALTHY/Normal 字段不能再被 AI 提升为 Process Condition 结论。
与 E2 冲突的评估数量和端口/整体 Condition 结论会确定性收敛到 E2 结果，并继续由现有 Grounding Validator 重新验证。
默认 AI 问题升级为综合操作员提示，一次覆盖运行状态、Condition、Coverage、Criteria Source、Evidence 和优先措施。
de: E2 Deterministic Evaluation ist nun die letzte Autorität dafür, ob eine Port-Condition tatsächlich ausgewertet wurde; konfigurierte Criteria oder rohe HEALTHY/Normal-Felder dürfen nicht in ein Process-Condition-Urteil hochgestuft werden.

Zu E2 widersprüchliche Auswertungszahlen und Port-/Gesamt-Condition-Aussagen werden deterministisch auf das E2-Ergebnis reduziert und anschließend vom unveränderten Grounding Validator erneut geprüft.
Die Standard-AI-Frage wurde zu einem umfassenden Operator-Prompt für Betriebszustand, Condition, Coverage, Criteria Source, Evidence und priorisierte Maßnahmen erweitert.
es: E2 Deterministic Evaluation pasa a ser la autoridad final sobre si una Condition de puerto fue realmente evaluada; Criteria configurado o campos raw HEALTHY/Normal no pueden elevarse a un veredicto de Process Condition.

Los conteos de evaluación y afirmaciones de Condition por puerto o globales que contradigan E2 se reducen de forma determinista al resultado E2 y se vuelven a validar con el Grounding Validator sin cambios.
La pregunta AI predeterminada ahora es una solicitud integral para estado operativo, Condition, Coverage, Criteria Source, Evidence y acciones priorizadas.
